# Glowing Emissive Stone!

### Heavily inspired by [GEO](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/glowing-emissive-ores). Check it out!

## Overview
This pack adds random emissive textures to stone types:
- Vanilla (15%): Andesite, Granite, Diorite
- Create (25%): Crimsite, Ochrum, Veridium, Asurine

## Requirements

### Fabric 1.18.2 - 26.1.x
- Continuity

### NeoForge 1.21 - 1.21.1
- Continuity
- Sinytra Connector
- Sodium

## Help

<details>
<summary>I don't want something to be emissive!</summary>

1. Unpack GES .zip file
2. Find the [stone_type]_em_e.png
3. Delete it
4. Compress back into .zip file (do this INSIDE the unpacked folder)
5. Put back into .minecraft/resourcepacks

[stone_type] - name of the block you don't want to be emissive.

[stone_type]_em_e.png is located in assets/[mod]/textures/block
</details>
